title: DF-VERIFY/1 — trigger-receipt/v1 profile (parametric catastrophe settlement)
description: A signed, tamper-evident, independently-reproducible record that a parametric catastrophe trigger ('metric operator threshold' at a location) was MET or NOT MET against an authoritative source reading. Carries the four properties that end a parametric payout dispute: (1) a pinned + hashed methodology, (2) the exact re-fetchable source_url plus a raw_reading_hash anyone can reproduce, (3) a deterministic determination (triggered + payout_factor + rationale) re-computable by any party, (4) an Ed25519 signature (independently time-stamped by an independent RFC 3161 authority via /v1/anchor). The neutral calculation-agent-of-record artifact a parametric insurer, reinsurer, regulator, or smart contract settles against. Detached Ed25519 signature over the object minus its `signature`, json-sorted-compact. SCOPE: attests what the official source reported and what the pinned methodology implies — NOT ground-truth physical loss.

peril.description: earthquake | tropical_cyclone | flood | excess_rainfall | wildfire | drought | volcanic | space_weather | weather

contract_ref.description: opaque caller/policy id — MUST NOT contain PII

trigger_definition.description: The trigger as pinned at contract inception. The methodology is frozen and hashed so nobody can move the goalposts after the event.

methodology.description: human-readable statement of the exact deterministic determination function

methodology_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the pinned methodology — re-computable by any party

observation.description: What the authoritative source actually reported. source_url is re-fetchable by anyone; raw_reading_hash is sha256 of the exact upstream payload so a third party can confirm the reading was not altered.

event_id.description: the source's own event id, when applicable

raw_reading_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical source reading (see hash_method)

hash_method.description: the exact, reproducible recipe to recompute raw_reading_hash from source_url

volatile_fields_removed.description: per-request fields stripped before hashing (e.g. generationtime_ms) so the hash is reproducible

determination.description: Deterministic result of applying the pinned methodology to the observation — re-computable by any party. Dynamic Feed executes a pre-agreed function and signs the result; it exercises no judgement.

payout_factor.description: 0.0–1.0; binary or stepped per the pinned methodology
